description: This file contains functions and classes for manipulating and analyzing computational graphs in PyTorch's FX framework, including node replacement, size calculation, and tensor metadata extraction.

classes.name: size_bytes
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing the size of tensor data in bytes, including output and total size.

methods.name: replace_target_nodes_with
methods.description: Replaces nodes in a FX graph module matching old operation and target with new operation and target.

methods.name: get_size_of_all_nodes
methods.description: Calculates and updates size information for all nodes in a FX graph module.

methods.name: get_tensor_meta
methods.description: Retrieves tensor metadata from a node, raising an error if absent.

methods.name: get_size_of_node
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a node's tensor data, including parameters if it's a module.
